ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: split: 0.5 tsp for prawns, 1 tsp for the tomato mixture

ingredients.name: Tomatoes
ingredients.notes: half finely chopped, half cut into wedges

ingredients.name: Dried crushed chillies
ingredients.notes: Kashmiri-style for colour and mild heat

ingredients.name: Mint leaves
ingredients.notes: a small handful, scattered to finish

steps.instruction: Toss the prawns with the turmeric and half a teaspoon of salt and set aside to marinate briefly. Finely chop half the tomatoes and cut the remaining tomatoes into wedges; set both aside separately.
Heat the coconut oil in a large, deep frying pan over medium heat. Add the shallots (or onion) and fry for about 5 minutes until soft and translucent.

Add the garlic, ginger, pandan leaf and curry leaves, and stir-fry for about a minute. Add the crushed dried chillies and cinnamon, and stir-fry for a further 2 minutes until the mixture turns fragrant.
Add the finely chopped tomatoes, green chilli, leek, black pepper and the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt. Stir-fry for about 5 minutes until the tomatoes soften into the base.

Add the marinated prawns, green pepper strips and tomato wedges. Cook for a further 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the prawns are just cooked through. Stir in the lime juice, scatter over the mint leaves, and serve immediately.
